Class GameEnd

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.States.State
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.States.GameEnd
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GameEnd extends State
Represents the final state of the game in the Finite State Machine.

This state handles the resolution of final events, calculates the end-game scoring for all players, determines the final standings (breaking ties with food), and broadcasts the winner and results to all clients.
